chapter_title: Onderon: Iziz, the tomb on Dxun and the battle for the palace
about: Story state every completed run of the chapter ends with, for a skip-to-the-end feature. Curated in tools/questdb/chapters.py; values marked certain = false were worked out by reading the scripts or seen in one real save, not proven for every run.

journal.set_by: dialog kavar E4 (506ond); 95 is the dark-side end
dialog vaklu E40 / E49 (506ond); 91 is the dark-side end
k_501_enter (501ond) on the return to the spaceport (502OND_End_First 2)
dialog cp_terly R2 (a_visa_quest|1, 502ond): the lowest of the second-visa endings 91 to 95, any of which is at or above it

globals.name: 000_Kavar_Dead
globals.note: light side: the master lives; the dark side sets 1 (dialog vaklu E4) and 650dan reads it

globals.name: 003EBO_G0T0_BAO_2
globals.note: the table sets 1 with CUT_BAO_G0T0_1 and k_003ebo_enter raises it to 2 on the next entry, which plays CUT_BAO_G0T0_2 (dialog bao_g0_2: a_adj_dex|1 on slot 3); a run has usually seen it by now, but the editor cannot raise slot 3's dexterity, so 1 leaves that scene to the next entry

globals.name: 003EBO_G0t0_Remote
globals.note: dialog g0t0rem1 E3 (003ebo); CUT_G0T0_REMOTE_2 (000_Jedi_Found above 2) is left to the game

globals.name: 403DXN_Return_Trigger
globals.note: a_set_return (dialog mand_cs2 E0, 403dxn) copies 000_Jedi_Found when the party comes back from Iziz; only c_kelborn_mes reads it, and CUT_MSG_FROM_KELBORN keeps the message from playing again

globals.name: 403DXN_Second_Visit
globals.note: dialog t3kelbrn E0 (003ebo), the message that calls the party back

globals.name: 411DXN_Complete
globals.note: a_leave_411 (dialog xarga R5, 411dxn) after the tomb; a_to_iziz2 then flies to 511ond and the camp's scripts treat the tomb as done

globals.name: 411DXN_Tempt
globals.note: a_temptation|0 (dialog ritlead R25, 411dxn, the light reply: a_lighthigh): the tomb team's leader refuses; 2 is a_temptation|1 (R20). The party's own dialogs (chitin) and c_baodur_tempt read it

globals.name: 411DXN_Tempt_NPC
globals.note: the slot of the companion who led the tomb team (a_temptation: 0, 4, 7, 9 or 11); depends on the party, left unchanged

globals.name: 500OND_Civil_War
globals.note: dialog vaklu E40 (506ond), the light-side end of the war; 1 is set on the return to the camp (dialog kelborn E15 / E63, 403dxn); 3 is the dark side's. Read by dialog geeda (301nar) and 904kreia (904mal, == 3)

globals.name: 500OND_DarkSide_Iziz
globals.note: light side: never set (its only writer is a_endgame case 8 / 10). The dark side sets 1 in the cantina (dialog tobin R38, a_endgame|8); read later by 221tel and 222tel (c_500darkside, k_221tel_enter, k_222tel_enter, dialog grenn)

globals.name: 500OND_Turret
globals.note: a player's choice: the turret terminal in 505ond (dialog term_acc R8, a_505turret) sets 1, and a_check_turret on the transition To_506 (504ond) sets 2 only when it is still 0. Left unchanged

globals.name: 501_FIRST_ENTER
globals.note: k_501_enter on the first entry of 501ond

globals.name: 501OND_Mand_Join
globals.note: k_501_enter sets 1 on the first entry of 501ond whenever it is still 0 (its only test; it adds slot 2 by template on the same branch), and nothing else writes it, so every run leaves 1. Only k_501_enter reads it

globals.name: 502OND_Dhagon_Free
globals.note: a_alibi_end2 (dialog mp_riike E44): the alibi proven

globals.name: 502OND_End_First
globals.note: a_dhagon sets 1 before the cantina, a_endgame case 4 (503ond) sets 2 when the meeting is broken up (read from a_endgame's own code; the call with parameter 4 is not in a conversation the tools list). Every run reaches 2: k_501_enter gives escape_merchant 90, which this chapter's journal holds, only at 2, and the shuttle back to the camp needs it. Read by k_501_enter, the shuttle dialogs (403dxn, 501ond), c_kelborn_mes and a_galaxymap (003ebo)

critical_path.what: 501ond OnEnter: 501_FIRST_ENTER; slot 2 joins here if the camp did not add him (501OND_Mand_Join 0); on the return from the cantina (502OND_End_First 2) journal escape_merchant 90
journal master_palace 30, the alibi starts (docalibi 10 and 20)
journal master_palace 40: the contact is freed (502OND_Dhagon_Free, a_alibi_end2 on E44)
dialog dhagon R13: 502OND_End_First 1, StartNewModule 503OND From_502OND_Dhagon (the meeting in the cantina)
journal escape_merchant 20 on the way back to the spaceport
dialog shuttle R2: OndMov06, StartNewModule 403DXN From_501OND
dialog mand_cs2 E0 back at the camp: 403DXN_Return_Trigger = 000_Jedi_Found; the party then leaves on the Ebon Hawk
after another master is found: 403DXN_Second_Visit 1, master_palace 60 (E3, light) or 65 (E2, dark); CUT_MSG_FROM_KELBORN keeps it from replaying
master_palace 70, 500OND_Civil_War 1 (E69 and 75 on the dark side)
dialog kelborn R56: StartNewModule 410DXN From_403DXN, the tomb
journal deadline 90, 500OND_Civil_War 2 (the light-side end of the war)
dialog kavar E7: the masters' count + 1
dialog talia E3: 10000 credits and the museum relics still in place
dialog talia R10: 506OND_End 1, PlayMovie OndMov06, StartNewModule 401DXN From_506OND
